description: Create a new thought with optional type, color, label, and parent link. Requires npub for credit billing.

brain_id.description: The ID of the brain (uses active brain if not specified)

dpop_token.description: Proof that the caller holds npub. Either the grant envelope that receive_npub_proof returned, or the raw JSON of a kind-27235 Nostr event signed by npub: content "", a `u` tag holding this tool's exact name from tools/list, created_at within 60 s of now, and a random `nonce` tag.

kind.description:
Kind of thought to create — 1=Normal (default) or 2=Type.
Tags and Events are NOT created via kind (the API rejects those
values); model them as Normal thoughts carrying the appropriate
type_id from get_types (e.g. the "Event" type).

npub.description: The patron's Nostr public key (npub1...). Tool fees are paid from this patron's balance; dpop_token proves the caller holds it.

source_thought_id.description: ID of the source thought to link from

type_id.description: ID of the thought type to assign

name: brain_create_thought
title: Create a thought
